native_unmapped_method: Raw source minRGB>225 and max-min<25, only components within native paper ROI touching its 300px inset; close7 and fill enclosed ink/road holes. ROI is not a blanket geology exclusion.
water_window_method: Native median9 RGB threshold (native_water_rule override, otherwise R>215 G>235 B>195 G-R>=8); source-water windows/regions plus conservative native water interior polygons, native mapped-island exclusions take priority; applied after majority, never global pale exclusion
water_evidence: Native ЧАРДАРИНСКОЕ ВОДОХРАНИЛИЩЕ label and cyan shoreline paint in native crop2450,1550–3650,2200. Source-specific blue test only in bounded reservoir window; pale islands/peninsulas retained, a conservative actual open-water core avoids native linework speckles; no imposed modern shore. Structural annotations remain in Scan; Colors is not a submerged-geology interpretation.

source_rights: Source rights remain with authors/rightsholders; no open redistribution license established. Native scans, excerpts and source-derived vectors are excluded from any repository software license. Hosting on Geokniga is not proof of an open license.
method: Actual legend-swatch Lab segmentation, not SAM. Text/hatch filtering and majority smoothing; no removed-small-region holes or nearest-neighbor geological infill. Corrected Kazakhstan border including Baikonur is unchanged.
